page.description: Peppermint OS Devuan-based ISO: size, architecture and a SHA-256 computed by ROMinit.
page.intro: A lightweight desktop with a small default app set, here built on Devuan instead of Ubuntu. One amd64 image.
pros: Small footprint, suited to older machines.
cons: The project publishes no SHA-256 for this ISO, so the hash here is computed by ROMinit.
Continuous delivery: the image name carries the build date (2026-07-09), not a version number.
The Commons screenshot shows Peppermint 10, not this build.
page.previewNote: A stock screenshot of Peppermint OS 10 from Wikimedia Commons. It is not this build and not a ROMinit recording: no image was written and nothing was booted for this page.

shot.alt: Peppermint OS 10 desktop with the Xfce panel
shot.caption: Stock screenshot of Peppermint OS 10 · not this build, no USB written, no boot tested.

page.status: One image: the Devuan-based amd64 ISO, written with dd or any image writer. Writing erases the stick; the installer then partitions or erases the target disk. Its SHA-256 was computed by ROMinit from the official download on 2026-10-27; the project publishes no digest. The version is the build date (2026-07-09).
